notes.title: May 1st, 2018: Long overdue updates!
notes.notes:
It has been a difficult few months at Blak Iron, and we have some updates that have been long overdue. The major updates are that the frozen north, the Frozen Forests of Balerun are now available for play! Navigate the maze of pathways to the north and discover whole new resource locations as well as a bit of a teaser for the upcoming Darkling tribes to come later this month as well as a plethora of side quests, gladiator arenas, and additions to the main quest line!

Next on the update list is that the option to obtain the Launch Bow has been removed. If you claimed your Launch Bow prior to this date and by chance lose it by some means, you can get another from the Update Vendor in the Pury District of the Carver Outpost!

Another update is that our beloved Seannafair of the Isle of Sleeping Light has been removed and replaced with a newer pink hair Seatru! She has taken the place of Seannafair without taking away from her role as a guide for you as you take your first steps into the world of Galamar!

Updates coming in the next month are going to be a doozy so stay tuned for more coming from Blak Iron Studios!

notes.title: Dec 5, 2017: PRICE DROP and new maps!
notes.notes:
After careful review, Blak Iron Studios has decided to reduce the price of Salvation in Corruption to 0.99$ on Steam. We will be adding not only free updates to the game, but we will also be adding low cost DLC in the near future! So, if you had Salvation in Corruption on your Wishlist, now is the perfect time to go through with your full purchase and let your friends know!

Also, beyond the change in price, comes the addition of the Frozen Forests of Balerun to the north of the Carver Outpost! This frozen maze will include various monsters, treasures, as well as the Ice Tribes and the various Darkling Houses within! Coming with that will be specific Darkling weapons given out as rewards for a special combat minigame coming with the Ice Tribes that you will discover within in the coming weeks!

We hope you enjoy the updates and many more to come! 

All the best,
Chris at Blak Iron Studios

notes.title: Nov. 17, 2017: Special thanks and upcoming goodies!
notes.notes:
The first week launch of Salvation in Corruption has passed and we have begun to take the game to the next level! Here are some announcements for the upcoming days as well as some patches!

Patches:
-Ryga Berry bushes on the path to the Carver Outpost have been corrected. Before, there could be no interaction, now that has been properly fixed. 
-Raw ore deposits in the Gangomar mines have been fixed. Before, there could be no interaction, now that has been properly fixed. 
-Basic wood cutting stations on the path to the Carver Outpost have been fixed. Before, there could be no interaction, no that has been properly fixed. 

Coming December 10th:
-Coming to the north is the Frozen Forests of Balerun. Coming with it are new crafting stations, new cities to explore, monster, and 3 new quests in the Darkling quest line. 
-To the east lies the Fenix Outpost. Coming with it is a fresh new pocket filling minigame, quests, shops and 2 new skilling stations. 
-To the south we see the forest inhabited by orck tribes. Coming with it are mew quests, new skills, and of course new quests!

Stay tunes for more updates for Salvation!

notes.title: Nov 4th, 2017: Opening Month Goodies!
notes.notes:
Who doesn't like an early-bird special? Salvation in Corruption is in the final few days of pre-order, and we would like to thank everyone who was here at the beginning days of this game by adding a special set of gear to the game just for those who began their adventures in Galamar within it's first month of release.

Head to Borgi, a sharp-dressed salesman in the Carver Outpost Pury District just north of the Inn to receive the limited edition Launch Bow! This special edition Crossbow comes with a thunderous punch to be wielded by all who supported Salvation in Corruption during its early days!

Thank you for your continued support!

~Chris at Blak Iron Studios
